label: XATTRs mapping (Search)
type: a mapping kind for a document's extended attributes, available since Server 7.6.2. Static or dynamic, sharesOptionSetWith search:collection-mapping. Split onto its own page in Server 8.0's docs; Capella's twin (measured similarity 0.30) still bundles the equivalent content inline in create-type-mapping.md, gated by Advanced Mode UI rather than by version.
evidence: XATTRs mappings can be static or dynamic, based on whether you add Child Field Mappings.
You can only use XATTRs mappings on Couchbase Server version 7.6.2 or later.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a Search index mapping reach a document's extended attributes (XATTRs), and is that gated by version or by product?
